components.description: FMLA as described on the HR leave page: up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave for the employee's own serious health condition or to care for a family member with a serious health condition, after 12 months and 1,250 hours.
components.faculty_group_note: "eligible employees" of NSU (FMLA eligibility: employed with NSU for 12 months and 1,250 hours); no exclusion of faculty stated
components.eligible_parent_wording: "to care for themselves and/or to provide care for eligible family members with a serious health condition"
components.duration_note: The page says "up to 12 weeks"; the statute (29 U.S.C. 2612(a)(1)) says "a total of 12 workweeks of leave during any 12-month period".
components.medical_certification_note: Matrix sends a medical certification to the employee's or the family member's healthcare provider; a Fitness for Duty Form before return (when applicable).
components.relief_note: Formal leave of absence; relief not stated (R9). The page states "Working is not permitted while on a leave of absence."
components.statute_source: 29 U.S.C. 2612(a)(1)(C)-(D) (family member's and own serious health condition); eligibility 29 U.S.C. 2611(2)

components.description: NSU's self-funded Short Term Disability program: reduced salary for an approved disability period, after the employee's paid time off is exhausted; for employees working 19.2+ hours a week after 90 days of employment. No length or pay level stated on the saved pages.
components.mechanism_note: A general disability program; no childbirth-specific period, length or pay level is stated (V1 not met).
components.faculty_group_note: "eligible employees working 19.2 hours or more per week at NSU and who have successfully completed 90 days of employment"; no exclusion of faculty stated
components.service_requirement: working 19.2 hours or more per week and 90 days of employment
components.entitlement_note: The program is provided to eligible employees with no action to participate; approval (by the leave administrator) decides eligibility for payment for a disability, i.e. the arrangements and the medical finding, not whether the program exists (V2).
components.medical_certification_note: Matrix determines eligibility for payment; medical certification returned by the employee's healthcare provider.

sequence.note: salary is reduced (STD pay begins) only after paid time off is exhausted, within the approved disability period

notes: missing = no_policy_on_page under the rule for records with no governing document (reader instructions §3): none of the three usable sources is a governing document for faculty leave. 2018_00_link is the Academic Affairs 'Academic Policies and Procedures' navigation page; it holds no policy and only lists a 'Faculty Policy Manual' link, which is not saved. 2018_01_hr_leaves_of_absence is an HR 'How to Request a Leave of Absence' page summarising FMLA, Medical Leaves of Absence and Short Term Disability administration (Matrix) and the required use of paid time off. 2018_02_hr_life_and_disability_std is an HR benefits page summarising Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Basic Life/AD&D and optional life insurance.

Governing documents cited but not saved: the NSU Faculty Policy Manual (2018_00); NSU's Leave Policies (www.nova.edu/portal/hr/policies/index) and the NSU employee policy manual (2018_01); the Short Term Disability Program Description (2018_01, 2018_02); the Group Long Term Disability Insurance Certificate (2018_02); also the Leave of Absence Paid Time Off Calculator (2018_01) and the Group Accident (AD&D) and Group Life Insurance Certificates (2018_02, not relevant to leave).

No saved source mentions maternity, paternity, parental, childbirth, adoption or pregnancy leave, modified duties, tenure-clock extension, or part-time options. 'Medical Leaves of Absence' is named once (administered by Matrix) with no terms, so it is not coded as a component; its governing policy is not saved.

The three HR-page provisions (STD, LTD, required PTO use) are flagged summary_only: they appear only on HR summary pages and the governing documents (STD Program Description, NSU leave policies, LTD certificate) are not saved. FMLA (c1) is verified against the saved statute (statute texts 2026_00, 2026_01) and is not flagged.

Faculty group: the HR pages address 'eligible employees' (benefits-eligible, 19.2+ hours a week) without excluding faculty, so main_campus_tenure_stream is coded (schema §2b); no saved source names faculty specifically.

Reference date 2018-02-27. The HR pages are undated; their Wayback captures are 2018-03-03 (reference academic year 2017-18), so they are accepted as in force; the navigation page capture is 2018-05-08.
Statutory baseline (US; no FL rows in statutory_baseline.csv): FMLA -> c1; Federal Employee Paid Leave Act -> not applicable. No Florida statute is named in the documents.

Chain, birth parent: FMLA up to 12 weeks (own serious health condition) with own paid time off used within it from its start -> STD reduced salary after PTO is exhausted (no length stated); LTD unlinked (no length, schema §2).
